question: What is the meaning of disposed material in relation to end of life?
description: Disposed material refers to the materials that are sent to landfill or other waste scenarios at the end of life of a product. This is one of the waste scenarios estimated in the Circular Material Passport. The percentage of disposed material is calculated based on the quantities of the product or its components sent to different waste scenarios.

3.3.3.  Section 2: Product context – Use and location 
The second section of the Circular Material Passport focuses on the existing products in a building. It 
provides information on their use and location to estimate the potential for reuse and recovery (Table 
3).

lives, as defined in the Level(s) framework for building tier 2, shall be used.
